description: Advisories the dependency gate accepts in every repository, each with its reason and the date it is looked at again. The gate reads this file from main, so a change here applies without re-pinning callers. An entry that has expired fails the scan again; renew it with a new reason or remove it once the fix lands. Decisions that concern one repository only belong in that repository's osv-scanner.toml.

advisories.reason: minimatch is fixed only in 11.0.1. Repositories get 3.x, 5.x, 9.x and 10.x through eslint, typescript-eslint, glob and other build and test tooling whose declared ranges do not allow 11, and versions are not forced outside declared ranges. The denial of service needs attacker-controlled glob patterns, which that tooling does not take. Re-check when the tooling moves to minimatch 11.

glob is fixed only in 14.0.2, a major version outside the ranges declared by the build and test tooling that brings in 11.x and 13.x, and versions are not forced outside declared ranges. The AbortSignal bypass needs a caller that cancels a glob walk, which that tooling does not do. Re-check when the tooling moves to glob 14.

deepmerge has no fixed release (4.3.1 is the latest). It comes in through @rollup/plugin-node-resolve at build time and merges only build configuration, never untrusted input. Re-check when a fix or a replacement lands.
